cross_sectional_company_level.interpretation: Tests whether companies with generally larger real stock reactions to news also have generally larger Polymarket reactions, aggregating away event-level noise. A positive, significant correlation here would be a genuinely new, different claim from anything tested in scripts 24-27 (which all failed at the event level).

within_company_fixed_effects.conclusion: Within-company variation does not beat a flat baseline on val either -- cross-company heterogeneity does not appear to be masking a hidden relationship.
